on_invariant_break: classify INVALID_TREATMENT and STOP. No mid-run repair.
MONITORING_DISCIPLINE: Only operational and treatment-integrity signals are monitored: process health, auditor trips, exposure equality, tied exposures, legacy-path calls, assignment drift. Intermediate performance MUST NOT be used to alter the run.

EVAL_BOUNDARY.rule: This authorizes TRAINING only. EVAL is a separate decision after the terminal checkpoint is frozen.

INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_R.retention: may fall below V1's 0.9816 by design, since each latent is trained toward its specialist even where that specialist is locally worse; reported as context, never promoted to a gate
